business: MULL所对应的原Mullen Automotive现Bollinger Innovations主要开发、组装和销售Class 1、Class 3及Bollinger Class 4商用电动车，面向城市配送、车队和公共部门电动化需求。

upstream.name: Roush Industries
upstream.note: 为Bollinger B4 Class 4电动卡车提供合同制造、工程验证和生产支持

upstream.name: Our Next Energy
upstream.note: 为Bollinger B4供应电池包，是中型商用电动车核心BOM环节

upstream.name: Qiantu Motor / CH-Auto
upstream.note: 提供Qiantu K50相关知识产权、整车套件和零部件合作，主要关联乘用性能EV项目而非当前商用车主线

upstream.name: Syncron
upstream.note: 提供保修管理系统和售后运营软件，支撑商用车客户服务体系

upstream.name: EO Charging
upstream.note: 为Bollinger商用车队客户提供充电和车队电动化解决方案，偏生态合作伙伴

downstream.name: Randy Marion Automotive Group
downstream.note: 战略授权经销商和大额采购方，采购Mullen Class 1/3商用EV用于分销给车队客户

downstream.name: Momentum Groups
downstream.note: 采购Bollinger B4 Class 4电动卡车，用于车队管理、移动充电和改装应用

downstream.name: Doering Fleet Management

downstream.name: MGT Lease Company

downstream.name: National Auto Fleet Group
